title: Servepath Latency Slateboard — model & route p50/p95/p99 with streaming vs batch split
text:
Servepath Latency Slateboard — model & route p50/p95/p99 with streaming vs batch split

description:
Motivation: product and infra teams need a single, explorable dashboard that surfaces end-to-end latency distributions (p50/p95/p99) broken down by model and route while explicitly differentiating streaming vs non-streaming (blocking) I/O modes. Existing boards show percentiles and per-route numbers but are noisy, lack a unified serve-path attribution, and make it hard to correlate tail spikes with traces.

Goal: deliver a "slateboard" UI panel and underlying metrics pipeline that: (1) computes per-request serve_path timing buckets, (2) exposes p50/p95/p99 heatmaps by model+route and I/O mode, (3) overlays trace-sampled tail markers with links to trace IDs, and (4) supports time-shift comparisons and baseline bands for regression detection. The slateboard is intended for SREs, infra PMs, and model-release owners to quickly triage regressions and identify whether streaming vs non-streaming changes explain latency shifts.

Scope: metrics/aggregation, tracing hook adjustments to attach serve_path tags, dashboard design + Grafana implementation, alert rule drafts for p95 regressions, and rollout to prod telemetry pipelines.

Out of scope: changes to serving runtime kernels or batching algorithms; those will be handled by separate ENG tickets if the slateboard points to them.

acceptance_criteria:
Aggregated metrics: pipeline produces per-minute p50/p95/p99 for each (model, route, io_mode) tuple for the last 90 days
Serve_path attribution: each request has a serve_path tag (ingest, model_infer, postprocess, network) attached and logged so breakdowns stack correctly
Dashboard: Slateboard displays a matrix view with rows = models, columns = routes, cell shows p50/p95/p99 bands and streaming vs batch toggle
Trace links: cells show tail markers; clicking a tail opens the corresponding trace (sampled) in the trace viewer
Comparisons: support time-shift (compare to baseline window) and auto-highlight >20% p95 regressions
Alerts: a draft alert rule for p95 increase by model+route+io_mode exists and is identifiable in the console alert editor

implementation_notes:
Metrics pipeline: add new aggregated metrics job that consumes OTel spans/metrics from the metrics ingestion topic, computes histograms per (model,route,io_mode,serve_path) and writes rollups to the metrics warehouse. Use percentile approximation (t-digest) to compute p50/p95/p99. Instrumentation: add 'io_mode' tag (values: streaming, blocking) and 'serve_path' stage labels to existing tracing hooks. Dashboard: build a new Grafana panel plugin (slateboard) that renders small-multiples matrix and banded percentiles; include streaming vs blocking stacked bars inside each cell. Trace sampling: increase tail sampling for requests > p95 to 10% for 48 hours when investigating. Backfill: run a 7-day backfill job for historic comparison during rollout.

updates:
2026-03-10 Anika Sharma: Created ticket after backlog grooming. Added initial scope and success criteria.
2026-03-11 Luca Moretti: Spikes: validated feasibility of t-digest rollups in metrics job; prototyped matrix cell rendering in storybook.
2026-03-12 Design review (Priya Rao): Suggested in-cell mini-sparkline for recent trend and separate color for stream vs batch bands. Added to design artifacts.
2026-03-13 SRE (Jamal Ortiz): Requested stronger trace correlation: include request_shape and token_count tags for tail sampling isolation.
2026-03-14 Luca Moretti: Implemented serve_path tagging in dev build and plumbing to metrics topic; PR opened (linked). Next: build Grafana panel and wire trace links.

qa_plan:
Unit tests for histogram rollup and t-digest accuracy bounds; integration test: inject synthetic requests with known latency distributions and verify p50/p95/p99 in the warehouse match expected within 2%. End-to-end test: dashboard renders cells for synthetic model/route, clicking tail opens trace viewer with correct trace ID.

rollout_plan:
1) Deploy metrics job in staging and run 7-day backfill. 2) Deploy slateboard panel to staging Grafana, review with infra and modeling teams. 3) Enable in prod in read-only mode for 24 hours, validate numbers vs existing boards. 4) Flip to writable and announce to teams; enable alerting in a paused state for 48 hours before activation.

notes:
Keep sensitive fields out of dashboard links. Coordinate with Privacy/Compliance if any sampled traces contain user-identifiable data. Work with Platform to budget additional storage for increased histogram retention.
